subject: reasoning
question:
P@Q means 'P is the sister of Q'

P & Q means 'P is brother of Q'

P # Q means 'P is the mother of Q'

If A # B @ C & D # E @ F, then how is B related to F?
solution:

A # B @ C & D # E @ F → A is mother of B, B is sister of C, C is brother of D, D is mother of E, E is sister of F.

Clearly, B is aunt of F.

Hence, '**Aunt**’ is the correct answer.
